doc: Per platform and chat app: how a tapped reply reaches the input box TODAY. Statuses: fresh-verified (target re-read right before writing and matched -> auto fill), copy-only (cannot be proven -> the reply is copied, the person pastes), legacy-not-fresh-verified (still fills from a cached conversation name; must become fresh-verified or copy-only in S2, no permanent exception), unsupported (no adapter). This is a declaration checked by tests against the code, not a promise: when the code changes, this file changes in the same commit.
